title: The Lion's Ride
desc: The Lion's Ride: a free Dasara draw-the-path game for Navratri Day 6 by World of Wonders Studio. Draw a safe road through the thorny forest and Maa Katyayani rides her lion to Mahishasura's fort. English, Hindi and Kannada.
aria: A forest seen from above with thorn bushes, rocks and moving shadows. Draw a path with your finger from Maa Katyayani to the fort, then watch her lion ride along it.
